name: XLA_TAB_COMPILED_METADATA
description: This table contains the compiled status for each edition of the transaction account definition.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_DEFINITION_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the transaction account definition.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_DEFINITION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicate whether it is a seeded transaction account definition.

columns.name: EDITION_NAME
columns.description: Identifier of the currently active transaction accounts definition metadata.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the transaction account definition.

columns.name: HASH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier assigned  to the transaction account definition the first time it is compiled. The numeric seed comes from the sequence XLA_TAB_COMPILED_METADATA_S.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
